judge_notes: All three candidates returned an empty assay list. Confirmed against the paper: the only in vivo readouts are [18F]FDG-PET (regional glucose metabolism, metabolic covariance, voxel-wise analysis) and [18F]MHMZ-PET (5-HT2AR occupancy). Both were acquired under isoflurane anaesthesia, so the animal performs no behavioural task. Under the rubric these are imaging-only endpoints and are excluded. No behavioural assays are scored.
Identity and metadata fields come from the paper text, consistent with the qwen and deepseek4 candidates. gemma4 supplied no metadata.
Sex is 'both'. n_male = 35 (26 in the FDG study plus 9 in the MHMZ study); n_female = 22.
Age is not reported (only body weight), so confidence is low. qwen marked this 'high'; that was not inherited.
Handling is set to not_reported because the paper describes only arrival acclimation, not a handling protocol.
day_night_flipped is 'no' because the paper explicitly states a standard cycle with lights on 6 a.m. to 6 p.m.
Overnight fasting before PET scans relates to the imaging protocol, not a behavioural assay, so it is not recorded as a per-assay condition.
